name: Rauno Freiberg: Craft
oneLine: Vercel designer's archive of interaction experiments; a quiet masonry of looping video cards where the motion is the content.

palette.note: Page body, a barely-off-white that keeps white cards readable as raised
Card wells and full-width 'View Production' / 'Read Essay' button bars
Dark demo cards (Toolbar Morph, X-Ray, Staggered Text) with #EDEDED titles
Single filled yellow bar in the top barcode-style nav; the only chrome color

type.note: 13px/400 for nearly everything: titles, dates; sentence case, neutral tracking
14px/500 for full-width card buttons ('View Prototype'), centered
Big type appears only inside videos (e.g. 'Start Deploying' ~40px semibold); the chrome itself never goes above 14px

layout: Three-column masonry at 1440px, ~466px columns with ~10px gutters and 8px outer margin; cards are 12-16px rounded with a 1px hairline border.
Card anatomy is rigid: title top-left, date top-right, both 13px, a media well, then an optional full-width grey action bar.
Navigation is a ~200px abstract barcode of outlined rectangles and ticks centered ~70px from top, with ~75px of empty space before the grid; collapses to one column on mobile.
motion: 68 autoplaying muted video loops: each card is a live demo (morphing toolbar, gooey tooltip, minimap, graph slider) rather than a static thumbnail.
Demos show motion principles directly: staggered text reveal, spring-based tooltip, exclusion-tab pill sliding under cursor.
(inferred) Barcode nav animates its yellow segment between filter positions with a spring.
interactions: Barcode nav acts as a filter/scrubber; the yellow segment marks the current position.
Full-width card buttons open the production site, prototype, or essay.
steal: Rigid card anatomy (13px title left, muted date right, media, full-width action bar) for our experiments/ablation gallery of model runs.
Looping silent micro-videos or live canvases instead of static thumbnails in the results grid, e.g. reconstruction-error traces scrolling per channel.
The 'Graph Slider' pattern: a scrubbable line chart with a dot and floating time pill for exploring a telemetry series in the hero demo.
leave: 68 autoplaying videos on one page: heavy on bandwidth and attention; we should lazy-play only in-viewport cards and respect reduced-motion.
The cryptic barcode nav: charming on a personal portfolio but too opaque for recruiters who need obvious section labels.
